55.content:
Glitchless Category
The Glitchless Category is a defined speedrun category for the game Crown of Brine that prohibits any use of glitches, duplicate tricks, or unintended game exploits, focusing on intended mechanics and skillful planning.<SEP>Glitchless Category is a speedrun category for Crown of Brine focusing on avoiding all glitches to maintain authentic gameplay and fair competition.

56.content:
Solved Puzzles
Solved Puzzles are completed puzzle sequences in Crown of Brine that have been optimized for glitchless runs, emphasizing planning and route optimization without shortcuts.

57.content:
Leaderboard
The Leaderboard is a ranking system for Crown of Brine speedruns that could be separated to recognize glitchless runs distinctly from modded or exploit runs.

58.content:
Classic Mac Build
The Classic Mac Build is the original version of Crown of Brine, noted for being charming but difficult for verifying glitchless runs.<SEP>The Classic Mac Build is a version of Crown of Brine used in glitchless runs that preserves the original challenge feel and involves specific game mechanics without shortcuts or exploits.

Modded Versions
Modded Versions refer to altered builds of Crown of Brine that introduce shortcuts and other modifications, which blur the line between glitchless and exploit runs.

60.content:

Duplicate Exploits refer to the use of game glitches related to duplicating items or enemies in Crown of Brine, which are disallowed in the glitchless category.

61.content:

The Starter Guide is a proposed resource intended to help new runners in Crown of Brine understand and compete in the glitchless speedrun category.
